preservedResponsibilities: Actual source lifecycle/selection/notification member bodies use mandatory real EditDoc, ParaPortionList, InternalEditStatus, outer engine and source view declarations. Class is abstract: no original constructor is pretended and no production parser/undo/layout/style/view/application provider is supplied. Real SfxListener and StyleSheetUser role preserve model-use true. InitDoc keeps exact listener/owner reset/paragraph callback/spelling order. RemoveText, EnableUndo, SetText, DocModified, TextModified and ParaAttribsChanged retain ordering, source undo restoration on normal return only, old-height invalidation, upper-only selection clipping, current-node lookup and following-valid-paragraph CalcHeight call. Original insertion compensation updates both endpoints eagerly. Original non-YRS regular deletion update remains disabled by upstream #if0/FIXME. Remaining protected fields/callees are required abstract declarations, not no-op defaults.

Actual full ImpInsertText orchestration now replaces the abstract parser declaration: original compound undo calls, range deletion/word service dependencies, SAL line normalization/fuzz-only tab replacement, exact existing capacity block, actual text/tab features, source paragraph splits/invalidation and final selection update/notification order. Actual ImpInsertParaBreak overloads retain paragraph-limit identity return, real style listener, source strict misspell-copy/truncation behavior, real portion insertion, attribute invalidation/callback and final selection/notification order. Original InsertText and active-view getter bodies are included. Source original initial invalidation index, retained left misspell copies and ClearWrongs overrun remain preserved as CALC-435..437. Enclosing class remains abstract: source constructor, undo manager and other mandatory dependencies have no production substitutes.

Original complete InitScriptTypes/GetItemScriptType algorithms now consume actual field display units, source BreakIterator script queries, hint traversal, direction/script scanners and actual cached vectors. Native missing-portion/empty-node handling, field representative selection, one-unit supplementary behavior, gapped-hint lookup, endpoint-only membership/caret bias and one final language fallback are preserved (CALC-424/441..443). Actual orientation/default-language/scaling/paper/ref-device getters, GetEmptyItemSet, GetParaAttrib, IsRightToLeft and signed-integral GetColumnWidth retain original pool/default precedence and defined-arithmetic domain. Original CreateTextObject overload dispatch now delegates its private body to the same actual owner in impedit4.textobject; public object returns keep the EditTextObject base contract. BreakIterator factory and raw InitWritingDirections remain mandatory abstract dependencies, not default services. Concrete constructor/undo/layout/view/application/ScFieldEditEngine/DocImport admission and NatNum12 remain pending.
omittedResponsibilities: Concrete EditEngine/ImpEditEngine constructor/resources, full parser/undo/layout/view/style-notification implementations and ScFieldEditEngine CSV admission remain unported. Abstract dependencies are mandatory, not default substitutes. Native diagnostic/thread/lifetime/ABI and full QA are uncertified. NatNum12 and final CSV audit remain pending.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original lifecycle, position and notification member group is separated from unported constructor, input parsing, undo, layout, device, view and application responsibilities under unchanged source-file budgets. Source state/callee declarations remain mandatory and no alternate engine is admitted.
